reason: No cited evidence is provided to support any of the key premises. The claims about precipitate formation, magnetic anisotropy variations, and their effect on coercivity in this specific alloy are not backed by prior results.
premises: Nanoscale coherent precipitates can form in equiatomic FeCoNiCrMn via aging at ~600°C
Such precipitates create local variations in magnetic anisotropy
Local anisotropy variations serve as effective domain wall pinning sites
Domain wall pinning increases coercive field
A homogenized single-phase baseline lacks such pinning and has lower coercivity
